description.en: Animated React components built on shadcn/ui and Framer Motion for SaaS.
description.zh: 基于 shadcn/ui 与 Framer Motion 打造的现代化 SaaS 动效组件库。

content.en: Odyssey UI is a sophisticated React component system constructed on top of the shadcn/ui foundation and enriched by Framer Motion. Engineered specifically for complex SaaS products, it delivers fluid state changes, animated dashboards, and polished marketing blocks.
content.zh: Odyssey UI 是一套建立在 shadcn/ui 基础之上、由 Framer Motion 深度赋能的高阶 React 组件系统。专为中大型 SaaS 应用与科技初创平台量身定制，全库兼备扎实的无障碍逻辑与流畅细腻的状态过渡，助力团队打造高水准产品界面。
